arxiv-2001-08149.title: Algebraic and analytic properties of semigroups related to fixed point properties of non-expansive mappings Thanks: † Supported by NSERC Grant ZC912 Thanks: ‡ Supported by NSERC Grant 1280813
arxiv-2001-08149.creator: Anthony To-Ming Lau †, Yong Zhang ‡
arxiv-2001-08149.description: Abstract . The purpose of this paper is to give an updated survey on various algebraic and analytic properties of semigroups related to fixed point properties of semigroup actions on a non-empty closed convex subset of a Banach space or, more generally, a locally convex topological vector space.

arxiv-2011-12071.title: FOWD: A Free Ocean Wave Dataset for Data Mining and Machine Learning
arxiv-2011-12071.description: Abstract The occurrence of extreme (rogue) waves in the ocean is for the most part still shrouded in mystery, as the rare nature of these events makes them difficult to analyze with traditional methods. Modern data mining and machine learning methods provide a promising way out, but they typically rely on the availability of massive amounts of well-cleaned data.

arxiv-2308-14119.title: Semi-Supervised Learning in the Few-Shot Zero-Shot Scenario
arxiv-2308-14119.creator: Noam Fluss, Guy Hacohen, Daphna Weinshall
arxiv-2308-14119.description: Abstract Semi-Supervised Learning (SSL) is a framework that utilizes both labeled and unlabeled data to enhance model performance. Conventional SSL methods operate under the assumption that labeled and unlabeled data share the same label space. However, in practical real-world scenarios, especially when the labeled training dataset is limited in size, some classes may be totally absent from the labeled set.

arxiv-2511-07906.title: Twisted operator algebras of self-similar groupoid actions on arbitrary graphs Thanks: We thank Benjamin Steinberg for telling us the trick that produces closed but non-Hausdorff inverse semigroups, and to Josiah Aakre for drawing our attention to [ ExP17 ] *Theorem 18.8(2)(b) where a special case o
arxiv-2511-07906.creator: Bartosz K. Kwaśniewski, Alexander Mundey
arxiv-2511-07906.description: Abstract . We study self-similar groupoid actions on arbitrary directed graphs together with 𝕋 \mathbb{T} -valued twists that exhaust the second cohomology group of the associated Zappa-Szép product category. We define and analyse the associated universal, reduced, and essential C ∗ C^{*} -algebras, along with their Toeplitz versions and core subalgebras.

pmc-11297734.title: IVF laboratory management through workflow-based RFID tag witnessing and real-time information entry
pmc-11297734.creator: Man-Xi Jiang, Lei Guo, Sen Li, Xiao-Feng Xiao, Wei Chen, Shao-Qing Chen, Nan-Qiao Chen, Yuan-Yuan Sun, Guang-Li Zhang, Xiao-Hai Zeng, Yan-Mei Xiao, Li-Hua Fan
pmc-11297734.description: BackgroundDual-person inspection in IVF laboratories cannot fully avoid mix-ups or embryo transfer errors, and data transcription or entry is time-consuming and redundant, often leading to delays in completing medical records.MethodsThis study introduced a workflow-based RFID tag witnessing and real-time information entry platform for addressing these challenges.

pmc-11480435.title: Intercellular genetic tracing by alternative synthetic Notch signaling
pmc-11480435.creator: Kuo Liu, Shaohua Zhang, Xinfeng Meng, Hongxin Li, Jingting Zhu, Enci Wang, Muxue Tang, Mingjun Zhang, Bin Zhou, Lixin Wang
pmc-11480435.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). synthetic Notch (synNotch)-based intercellular genetic system called genetic tracing of cell‒cell contact (gTCCC) was developed. This system utilizes artificial ligands and receptors specific to sender and receiver cells, enabling successful genetic recording of cell‒cell contact in vivo1,2,9,10. However, the applicability of alternative synNotch versions for tracing cell‒cell contact in vivo has yet to be demonstrated to broaden its diverse application in multiple biological processes.

pmc-11647641.title: Marburg virus vaccine in Rwanda: A necessity for the control and prevention of future epidemics
pmc-11647641.creator: Christian Tague, Mayar Moustafa Budair, Maher Ali Rusho, Adolphe Karegeya, Mc Juan Muco Mugisha, Hermann Yokolo, Joshua Ekouo, Dujardin Makeda, Elie Kihanduka, Aymar Akilimali
pmc-11647641.description: d by the Marburg virus which belongs to the family of Filoviridae, like the Ebola virus. These Marburg epidemics particularly occur in the countries of East and Central Africa. Rwanda experiences outbreaks consistently as the virus spreads from its neighboring countries in that area. The development of vaccines constitutes a potential breakthrough in the eradication of the disease [1].

pmc-11691178.title: GLOBAL CLIMATE ATTITUDES IN AGING ADULTS: THE ROLES OF SCIENTIFIC TRUST AND LITERACY
pmc-11691178.creator: Bryce Van Vleet, Heather Fuller
pmc-11691178.description: Prior research has established that people with less scientific literacy are more distrustful of science. However, this link is not well understood in older age or in relation to climate change perceptions. Aging adults play an important role in and are particularly vulnerable to the effects of climate change.

pmc-12569553.title: Enhancing patient stratification methods for medication review during acute admissions
pmc-12569553.creator: Louise Westberg Strejby Christensen, Helle Gybel Juul‐Larsen, Line Jee Hartmann Rasmussen, Esben Iversen, Kim Peder Dalhoff, Ove Andersen, Morten Baltzer Houlind
pmc-12569553.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Medication review in the hospital is an effective tool for identifying inappropriate prescribing, but not every patient can receive one due to resource constraints. Thus, it is important to identify patients who stand to benefit most from medication review. Patients are typically identified for medication review based on number of medications and age, but this may not be the most efficient strategy for identifying patients at high risk of future adverse clinical outcomes.

pmc-12649785.title: The Balance Tracking System (BTrackS) for Postural Control Assessment/Training – a Decade of Research
pmc-12649785.creator: Daniel J Goble, Harsimran S Baweja, Joshua L Haworth
pmc-12649785.description: The Balance Tracking System (BTrackS) is a medical device developed over a decade ago as a low-cost and portable solution to expensive and cumbersome force plate balance measurement instruments. Consisting of the BTrackS Balance Plate and Assess Balance software, this technology is now employed worldwide by thousands of practitioners.

pmc-12955558.title: Prevalence and spectrum of coronary artery anomalies detected on coronary CT angiography
pmc-12955558.creator: Hassan Al-Balas, Abdulmajeed M. Mouhsen, Ghassab E. Ababneh, Mohammad A. Alkhalqi, Sohaib A. Alomari, Haya M. Jarrah, Albara H. Alotaibi
pmc-12955558.description: PurposeAdult coronary artery congenital anomalies prevalence ranges between 1% and 5.6% in general population. Although many of these anomalies are benign, asymptomatic, and discovered incidentally, some of them can be associated with serious cardiovascular events that may lead to sudden cardiac death. Coronary CT angiography (CCTA) is noninvasive imaging modality that can reliably detect these anomalies.

pmc-12978010.title: Hearing, Voice and Speech Disorders in 10-Year-Old-Boy with Facio-Scapulo-Humeral Dystrophy (FSHD) – Case Study
pmc-12978010.creator: Emilia Duchnowska, Bożena Kosztyła-Hojna, Maciej Zdrojkowski, Sarah Burton-Jones, Wojciech Kułak
pmc-12978010.description: PurposeThe aim of the study was to evaluate hearing, voice, and speech in 10-year-old boy with fascio-scapulo-humeral dystrophy (FSHD).Patients and MethodsHearing, voice, and speech were assessed in a 10-year-old boy with FSHD due to scarcity of detailed audiophonological assessment in this disorder.

pmc-13034337.title: Targeting SPP1+TAMs associated with liver metastasis reverses immunosuppression and synergizes with immunotherapy in colorectal cancer
pmc-13034337.creator: Yilin Lin, Zhihua Chen, Shidong Zhao, Long Zhao, Changjiang Yang, Mingxuan Zhu, Yingjiang Ye, Shan Wang, Zhanlong Shen
pmc-13034337.description: BackgroundTumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) are critically involved in colorectal cancer (CRC) progression, yet their spatial and metabolic heterogeneity across primary and metastatic microenvironments remains poorly defined, limiting therapeutic development.MethodsIntegrated single-cell RNA sequencing was performed on 998,204 cells from a multicenter cohort encompassing primary CRC, adjacent normal tissue, liver and lymph node metastases, and peripheral blood.

pmc-13475460.title: Self-reported side effects of tattooing: a cross-sectional study in the Swedish TABOO cohort
pmc-13475460.creator: Emelie Rietz Liljedahl, Thomas Rustemeyer, Anna Saxne Jöud, Christel Nielsen
pmc-13475460.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionTattooing is common in many populations, yet population-based data on side effects remain limited. We aimed to describe the occurrence of self-reported acute- and delayed-onset side effects following tattooing and investigate individual and tattoo-related determinants in a Swedish population.MethodsThe Swedish Tattoo and Body Modifications Cohort includes 13 049 participants, of whom 2633 reported having at least one tattoo and constituted the study sample.

pmc-13670779.title: Borderline personality disorder and substance use disorder: a clinical and psychopathological investigation
pmc-13670779.creator: Paola Bozzatello, Claudio Brasso, Giacomo Marin, Gabriele Lerda, Paola Rocca, Silvio Bellino
pmc-13670779.description: BackgroundBorderline Personality Disorder (BPD) is a severe psychiatric condition frequently associated with Substance Use Disorder (SUD), with high rates of comorbidity and poor clinical outcomes. Impulsivity and emotional dysregulation are core features shared by both disorders, suggesting common underlying mechanisms.

uslaw-usc-t16-s460m.title: 16 U.S.C. § 460m — Establishment
uslaw-usc-t16-s460m.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s460m.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LXX (Ozark National Scenic Riverways). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For the purpose of conserving and interpreting unique scenic and other natural values and objects of historic interest, including preservation of portions of the Current River and the Jacks Fork River in Missouri as free-flowing streams.
